Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Krakow hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 18 Krakow hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 7, Agoda at 3, Booking.com at 1, Priceline at 1 and Qantas Hotels at 1. These are the Krakow rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Krakow hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 8% ($8 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 7% at Ventus Rosa Boutique Aparthotel to 9% at Venetian House Market Square Aparthotel. At 7 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
